fusions.name: Many Hands Reach
fusions.desc: Flings 4 arms at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 water damage. 20% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Parrot Bite
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A beak snaps at it, dealing 20 water damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Arm in Every Pan
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 35% for 15 seconds. You restore 12 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Hidden Arm
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of water that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
